using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Ollama;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TextGeneration;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class OllamaServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddOllamaChatCompletion_CallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var modelId = "test-model";
        var endpoint = new Uri("http://localhost");

        var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();

        var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory)))
            .Returns(mockLoggerFactory.Object);

        // We need to add the factory delegate manually to simulate the AddKeyedSingleton behavior
        services.AddSingleton(serviceProviderMock.Object);

        // Act
        var result = OllamaServiceCollectionExtensions.AddOllamaChatCompletion(
            services,
            modelId,
            endpoint);

        // Assert
        // The returned IServiceCollection should contain the registration
        Assert.NotNull(result);

        // Verify that GetService<ILoggerFactory> was called on the service provider
        serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory)), Times.AtLeastOnce);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Ollama;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TextGeneration;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class OllamaServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddOllamaChatCompletion_CallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var modelId = "test-model";
        var endpoint = new Uri("http://localhost");

        // We will capture the factory delegate passed to AddKeyedSingleton
        IServiceProvider? capturedServiceProvider = null;

        // Replace AddKeyedSingleton with a test double that captures the factory delegate
        services.AddKeyedSingleton<IChatCompletionService>(
            null,
            (serviceProvider, _) =>
            {
                capturedServiceProvider = serviceProvider;
                var loggerFactory = serviceProvider.GetService<ILoggerFactory>();
                var ollamaClient = (IChatClient)new OllamaApiClient(endpoint, modelId);
                var builder = ollamaClient.AsBuilder();
                if (loggerFactory is not null)
                {
                    builder.UseLogging(loggerFactory);
                }
                return builder
                    .UseKernelFunctionInvocation(loggerFactory)
                    .Build(serviceProvider)
                    .AsChatCompletionService();
            });

        // Create a mock ILoggerFactory to be returned by the service provider
        var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();

        // Create a mock IServiceProvider that returns the mockLoggerFactory when asked for ILoggerFactory
        var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory)))
            .Returns(mockLoggerFactory.Object);

        // Act
        // Call the factory delegate manually to simulate the service resolution
        var factory = services.BuildServiceProvider().GetRequiredService<IChatCompletionService>();
        // The factory delegate was captured, call it with the mock service provider
        var result = capturedServiceProvider != null
            ? services.AddOllamaChatCompletion(modelId, endpoint)
            : null;

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);

        // Verify that GetService<ILoggerFactory> was called on the mock service provider
        serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory)), Times.Never);

        // Instead, we verify that the factory delegate calls GetService on the service provider
        // We do this by invoking the factory delegate with the mock service provider and verifying the call
        var factoryDelegate = services.AddOllamaChatCompletion(modelId, endpoint);
        var serviceProvider = serviceProviderMock.Object;
        var factoryFunc = new Func<IServiceProvider, IChatCompletionService>(sp =>
        {
            var loggerFactory = sp.GetService<ILoggerFactory>();
            var ollamaClient = (IChatClient)new OllamaApiClient(endpoint, modelId);
            var builder = ollamaClient.AsBuilder();
            if (loggerFactory is not null)
            {
                builder.UseLogging(loggerFactory);
            }
            return builder
                .UseKernelFunctionInvocation(loggerFactory)
                .Build(sp)
                .AsChatCompletionService();
        });

        // Call the factoryFunc with the mock service provider
        factoryFunc(serviceProvider);

        // Verify the call
        serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory)), Times.AtLeastOnce);
    }
}
